1.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVERECLAMATION_00832_TANKEN_033_000
1.description: O-Oh, you're here already! I was just taking an innocent look around. Promise.

2.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVERECLAMATION_00832_TANKEN_033_005
2.description: I think you're right about a cavern! If we had the right tools, we could break through this rock and see what's inside. Could be anything, right? Gold, riches...emergency exits...

3.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVERECLAMATION_00832_SYSTEM_033_000
3.description: The mammet-sized spelunking tools recipe has been added to the sanctuary crafting log. Deliver this set of tools to the determined digger once it has been crafted.

4.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVERECLAMATION_00832_TANKEN_034_000
4.description: Once you've prepared the right tools, give them to me and we'll see what's in this cavern. Maybe it's a secret way off the island! Ha ha! That was a joke!

5.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVERECLAMATION_00832_TANKEN_034_005
5.description: ...A-Are you giving these to me? Is it really okay to find out what lies beyond this wall?

6.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVERECLAMATION_00832_SYSTEM_034_000
6.description: Open the cavern wall?<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>※Once the cavern has been opened, the area cannot be returned to its previous state.<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>

9.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVERECLAMATION_00832_TANKEN_034_010
9.description: Thank you... Oh, thank you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! We'll dig like no mammet has ever dug before. For the future. For liberty!

10.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVERECLAMATION_00832_TANKEN_034_015
10.description: B-But don't you care about the gold!? The riches!? Th-They could be down there, you know! I'm only trying to help further your profits!

11.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVERECLAMATION_00832_TANKEN_034_020
11.description: There was a cavern after all. ...A fully sealed cavern with sturdy and impenetrable walls.

12.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVERECLAMATION_00832_TANKEN_034_025
12.description: I-I'm sure you'll find lots of useful things in here! Things we can collect for you and make for you and sell for you. Day in and day out. ...E-Excuse me, I need a moment to myself. Enjoy your new cavern, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>.

13.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVERECLAMATION_00832_SYSTEM_034_005
13.description: The crumbling caverns have been added as a location for granary foraging expeditions.

14.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVERECLAMATION_00832_TANKEN_038_000
14.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! I have wonderful news. I was just performing a thorough investigation of the cave for possible exits─er, <hex:021A020203>rocks<hex:021A020103>, when what should I spy but spriggans scuttling about with crystals the size of me!

15.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVERECLAMATION_00832_TANKEN_038_005
15.description: I thought I knew every nook and cranny of this island, but such a discovery is proof of hidden possibility...

16.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVERECLAMATION_00832_TANKEN_038_010
16.description: There must be another cavern somewhere! A passageway that leads far, <hex:021A020203>far<hex:021A020103> away from here and, er...to a vast deposit of crystals! That's right! Further riches might yet be yours!

17.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVERECLAMATION_00832_TANKEN_039_000
17.description: Have a look around and tell me if anything seems suspicious.

18.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVERECLAMATION_00832_TANKEN_040_000
18.description: A hollow wall!? I-I mean, yes...definitely worthy of further inspection.

19.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVERECLAMATION_00832_TANKEN_040_005
19.description: Hmm... The rock in this cavern is quite thick. We'll need better tools if we have any hope of bursting through that wall to the, er...<hex:021A020203>crystals<hex:021A020103> that lie beyond.

20.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVERECLAMATION_00832_TANKEN_040_010
20.description: Come and find me once you've finished making the tools. I'll be waiting here. Forever, if need be.

21.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVERECLAMATION_00832_SYSTEM_040_000
21.description: The splendiferous mammet-sized spelunking tools recipe has been added to the sanctuary crafting log. Deliver this set of tools to the determined digger once it has been crafted.

22.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVERECLAMATION_00832_TANKEN_041_000
22.description: Are the tools finished yet? ...How about now?

23.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVERECLAMATION_00832_TANKEN_041_005
23.description: Perfect... These tools are <hex:021A020203>perfect<hex:021A020103>! Just say the word, and we'll topple this rock before you can shout, “For liberty!”

24.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVERECLAMATION_00832_SYSTEM_041_000
24.description: Open the inner cavern wall?<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>※Once the inner cavern has been opened, the area cannot be returned to its previous state.<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>

27.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVERECLAMATION_00832_TANKEN_041_010
27.description: Oh I will, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I will! Stand back and prepare to witness our moment of destiny!

28.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVERECLAMATION_00832_TANKEN_041_015
28.description: A-Are you sure? Think of the crystals! Wouldn't you like to see all those shiny crystals!?

29.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVERECLAMATION_00832_TANKEN_041_020
29.description: ...As we suspected, there were crystals. A whole treasure trove of wealth. For you.

30.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVERECLAMATION_00832_TANKEN_041_025
30.description: No doubt it will prove useful in your endless efforts of development, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>. I, however, must rethink the worth of my own fruitless ambitions. P-Please excuse me...

31.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVERECLAMATION_00832_TANKEN_100_005
31.description: You're a visitor here, aren't you!? ...Tell me, what is your moral stance on smuggling someone off of an island? G-Generally speaking, of course!
